biotools.summary: Rosalution assists researchers study genetic variation 🧬 in patients 🧑🏾‍🤝‍🧑🏼 by helping select candidate animal models 🐀🐁🐠🪱 to replicate the variation to further research to derive, diagnose, and provide therapies for ultra-rare diseases. Developed by the UAB Center for Computational Genomics and Data Science (CGDS).
